name: Export frame
responsibility: Draws what an exported picture carries around its drawing: a title above it, and its legend under it or beside it, or the legend alone
description: framed_for_export moves the painted page down whole under a title band, with its atlas, sets the legend under the page or beside it, or draws the legend alone, and grows the page to hold them. Asked for nothing, it returns the page unchanged. exported_name starts the accessible name with the drawn title. Model answer turns a title asked for without words into the names of the model, view, variant and comparison. The legend counts the marks of the subjects the painted drawing placed, read from its atlas, and the page says which subjects those are, also when the legend is drawn alone.
